name: Churchgate: A Byler Visual Novel
source:
A short Byler visual novel inspired by the ‘Churchgate’ theory from Stranger Things Season 5, which predicts a church could act as a portal to danger.

[From [url=https://elmaxenjoyer.itch.io/churchgate-byler-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拜勒的一部短篇视觉小说，灵感来自《怪奇物语》第五季的“教堂门”理论，该理论预测教堂可能成为通往危险的门户。

[来自[url=https://elmaxenjoyer.itch.io/churchgate-byler-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
